name: Additional Business Process Format 23 Choice
definition: Choice between a standard code or proprietary code to specify the type of the additional business process, that is, a tax refund.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Standard code to specify the additional business process "tax refund" linked to a corporate action event.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Proprietary identification of the additional business process "tax refund" linked to a corporate action event.
